entities.summary: Iva Jovic is an American professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of No. 16 achieved on March 30, 2026, and a best doubles ranking of No. 159 reached in January 2026. She has won one WTA Tour title, at the 2025 Guadalajara Open.
